subject.title: feat(models): make per-agent model allowlist explicit; aliases/defaults no longer restrict

question: Should OpenClaw retain `modelPolicy.allow` as the persisted override-only contract after the migration and primary-selection safety gaps are repaired?
rationale: This PR adds a durable configuration and migration contract whose authorization semantics affect existing installations; the implementation defects are mechanical, but the permanent user-facing policy direction needs explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Keep the direction and repair safety gaps
options.body: Preserve the new explicit policy, migrate from resolved legacy config without dropping includes, and ensure primary/default execution is never filtered as an override.

options.title: Pause and redesign the migration boundary
options.body: Rework the config-write and doctor ownership model before accepting a new persisted policy marker.

recommendation.title: Keep the direction and repair safety gaps
recommendation.body: Preserve the new explicit policy, migrate from resolved legacy config without dropping includes, and ensure primary/default execution is never filtered as an override.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned author owns the proposed configuration contract and its upgrade semantics in this PR.
